question: Approve the DEV-51 shape to enter Pilot implementation: 31 pin sites tiered (8 tier-1, 5 split, 13 tier-2, 5 wording-only), tier-2 budget checkpoint at three measured cases against a cap of 8?

artifacts.summary: Recommend approval with one Captain checkpoint carried into build. The shape corrected the pin count (31 positive phrase-pin loop sites, 245 pinned phrases, not 19 or 20), tiered every site, and exercised each tier-1 observable (comparator exit codes, loader loaded set and declared_receipts, validate-admission digest, guard credential refusal). The tier-2 budget does not close: 18 candidate rules against a proposed cap of 8 cases, so build measures three cases and hands the Captain raise-the-cap, narrow-to-kernel, or route-back. Environment limits recorded: the behavior-diff trial copy has no work item (state dir is gitignored), the trial agent cannot write, and the instrument (engram behavior-diff 0.1.0, jq, claude CLI) is outside the repo and CI. reverse_recovery decision use: extend the 125 existing mechanism assertions rather than build a parallel instrument. AC-5 baseline: contract test PASS 50.7 s at f47fd8ca in a clean clone.
